asked.item: Is there a Blotato Make module for post analytics
Another way to get analytics into Make

verdict.reason: S2 says the Make module has no analytics yet, and S3 says to use Make's HTTP module with the analytics endpoints and API key header.

steps.text: No, the official Blotato Make.com module does not include analytics yet.
To pull analytics from a Make scenario, call the two endpoints on the Analytics page with Make's HTTP module, passing your API key in the blotato-api-key header.
